name: poolA_kbonus_background_dwarfs_v1.8
revision_log: v1.0 (commit 53c2cd7..a5f8fa6, 2026-10-17T12:02Z): first-screen thresholds and target list registered before any search.

v1.1 (commit c0b354d, 12:12Z): positive controls (kic-005689121, kic-007603200) FAILED the v1.0 screen because of three implementation bugs, fixed before any pool star was searched: (1) secondary-eclipse test used astropy depth_half (half-period model) instead of depth_phased (half-phase model); (2) odd/even sigma used the white-noise formal error instead of the empirical folded-box noise; (3) transit mask width could exceed short periods and crash the inverted run. Thresholds unchanged.

v1.1 control results: kic-005689121 PASS (P 13.76956 d, 1891 ppm, SDE 51.6, SNR_emp 20.1); kic-007603200 PASS twice (Kepler-138 c 13.781 d 612 ppm SDE 99; Kepler-138 d 23.089 d 372 ppm SDE 33.6 as second signal); neighbour kic-005689116 rejected; all inverted runs rejected.

v1.2 (commit a30c2fc, 12:18Z): added max_duty_cycle = 0.15 (duration/period) as a physical cut before any pool star was searched. Motivation: every inverted-run 'winner' in the controls was a 7-h box at P < 1 d (30-55% duty cycle). No other threshold changed. The Modal batch (ranks 101-6465) and the local pilot (ranks 1-100) ran with the v1.2 first screen (config_sha ccca76e8).

v1.3 (commit 90ae39a, 12:44Z): stage2_vetting block registered AFTER a 208-star partial triage of the Modal batch had been inspected (it revealed two false-positive classes: periodic variables/EBs and monthly-downlink-gap systematics at P 24-40 d) but before any pool star was vetted. Stage-2 results are therefore post-hoc relative to the stage-1 registration.

v1.4 (commit d04cfac, 12:47Z): event_chi2_const_pvalue_min = 0.001 replaced by event_reduced_chi2_max = 3.0 because the positive control KIC 5689121 (chi2 140.5 / 72 dof, p ~ 3e-6) would have FAILED the registered p-value version; formal per-event errors understate correlated noise (controls: reduced chi2 1.95 and 1.50; a gap systematic 25, a contact binary 36). Logged here on 2026-10-17 ~15:50Z after an audit noticed the missing entry.

v1.5 (2026-10-17 ~15:55Z, after the 11 v1.4 survivors and their pixel maps had been seen; POST-HOC): (a) tls_sde_min dropped: SDE computed over a +/-2% period window is not a calibrated statistic (it was the largest stage-2 killer, 358/448, including 16 stars that failed on nothing else); TLS formal snr >= 7.1 is kept. (b) snr_emp_pass2_min = 7.1 added (stage 2 previously had no empirical-SNR floor; kic-001577049 passed with 1.9). (c) secondary test made two-sided, |secondary_sigma| <= 3 (kic-009520080 shows a -4 sigma brightening at phase 0.5). (d) Estimators: stage 1 uses BLS weighted-fit depth_odd/depth_even/depth_phased with 60 random boxes; stage 2 uses unweighted box means on the masked re-detrend with 80 random boxes. Both the v1.4 survivor set (11) and the v1.5 set (23) are reported; the adversarial pass covers the union.

v1.5 pixel_localisation block registered after the first 11 pixel maps had been seen (POST-HOC): a quarter is inconclusive when the target lies within 0.5 px of the stamp edge or outside it, when fewer than 3 events are usable, or when fewer than 2 pixels exceed SNR 2; the deficit centroid carries a bootstrap error over events; verdict on-target requires >= 5 conclusive quarters with the target-to-deficit offset below its 2-sigma error and below the offset to every other Gaia source within 2 px of the stamp in >= 70% of them; offset requires the opposite in >= 70%; otherwise inconclusive. Earlier 'on target / plausible / weak / off target' labels in docs were descriptive, not registered.

v1.5 pixel rules RESULT (2026-10-17 ~16:40Z): the centroid-based verdict FAILED its positive control: KIC 5689121 came out 'inconclusive' (target within 0.5 px of the stamp edge in 9 of 13 quarters -> only 4 conclusive quarters, 2 on-target), and Kepler-138 c (the TPF host itself, bright) came out inconclusive because jitter-dominated core pixels fail the SNR>2 selection. Background sources sit at stamp edges by construction, so these rules are NOT used as a gate. Descriptive outputs are kept under runs/*/pixel_v15/. Informative anyway: kic-001577049 and kic-010782709 are 'offset' (deficit 26 and 9 arcsec from the target at 14 and 5 sigma).

v1.6 (2026-10-17 ~16:45Z, POST-HOC after the v1.5 pixel control failure): pixel verdict replaced by a chi-square model comparison that does not need a centroid and works at stamp edges. Per quarter with >= 2 usable events and a finite noise map, the missing-light map is fitted by (a) a point source (Gaussian, sigma 0.9 px) at the target's Gaia position, (b) a point source at each other Gaia source within 2 px of the stamp, and (c) a scaled copy of the out-of-transit image (a dip on whatever dominates the stamp). Summed over quarters: on-target requires sum(chi2_null - chi2_target) >= 25 AND sum(chi2_best_alternative - chi2_target) >= 25 over >= 5 quarters; offset requires some alternative to beat the target by >= 25; otherwise inconclusive. Must pass KIC 5689121 (and report Kepler-138 c, where the 'scaled image' and 'target' hypotheses coincide) before being read on pool stars. Centroid outputs remain descriptive.

v1.7 (2026-10-17 ~17:20Z, POST-HOC after the adversarial re-derivations of the v1.5 survivors had been read): stage2_vetting.n_events_min = 3 added. Motivation: kic-006515744 passed the v1.5 stage-2 verdict with n_events = 1 (events.csv has one usable event; event_dof 0), because the per-event criteria (frac_events_positive, event_reduced_chi2) are silent with one event, while stage 1 already required n_transits >= 3 on cadence counts rather than on usable events. The independent re-derivation found the signal single-cadence-wide, carried by two cadences, and absent from SAP flux (ratio 0.12). Only this star is affected: v1.5 count 23 -> v1.7 count 22. Result labelled post-hoc.

v1.8 (2026-10-17 ~19:20Z, POST-HOC method extension): season-stacked pixel localisation (pipeline/pixel_season_stack.py) for signals with too few transits per quarter for the v1.6 rule (which uses only quarters with >= 2 events). Event-differenced maps of all quarters in a Kepler season (same CCD channel) are averaged on one CCD-pixel grid; noise from 48 random-phase ephemerides; same models and thresholds as v1.6 (Gaussian sigma 0.9 px at the target vs null, vs every Gaia source within 2 px, vs a scaled image; on-target needs summed dchi2 >= 25 vs null AND vs best alternative over >= 3 seasons; offset needs an alternative to win by >= 25). Motivated by the 47.69-d second signal on kic-006699887 (v1.6: 4 quarters, inconclusive), whose v1.6 result had been seen; its season-stacked result had not. Required controls before use: KIC 5689121 on-target (run first: on-target, 357/226 over 4 seasons), kic-006699887 15.11 d on-target, kic-006367225 and kic-001577049 offset. Not used to change any Pool A stage-2 verdict.
target_list_rule: KBONUS-BKG v1.0 source catalogue; background extraction (kic != tpforg); not in Kuber Mehta's 1,800 searched sources; psffrac > 0.5, crowdsap > 0.7, >= 8 PSF quarters, G < 17.5; Gaia DR3 (CDS XMatch, 1 arcsec) dwarf by M_G vs BP-RP (|dMS| band -1.5..+2.0, parallax SNR > 5) or GSP-Phot logg > 4 when parallax poor; own KIC never a Kepler target (NASA Exoplanet Archive keplerstellar, any observed quarter). Ranked by expected SNR of a 2 R_earth, 10-day planet.

stage2_vetting.note: Registered after the first-screen controls and after a 208-star partial triage of the Modal batch revealed two dominant false-positive classes (periodic variables / EBs, and Kepler monthly-downlink or quarter-edge systematics at P 24-40 d), but BEFORE any pool star was vetted. Applied by pipeline/vet_batch.py; results are reported per criterion, never silently filtered.
stage2_vetting.event_chi2_note: Reduced chi-square of per-event local depths about their weighted mean. Formal per-event errors understate correlated noise: positive controls give 1.95 (KIC 5689121) and 1.50 (Kepler-138 c); a gap systematic gave 25 and a contact binary 36. Ceiling fixed at 3.0 on 2026-10-17T13:20Z after the control calibration, before any pool star was judged.
stage2_vetting.note_v15: v1.5: tls_sde_min removed; snr_emp_pass2_min and two-sided secondary added; see revision_log.
stage2_vetting.note_v17: v1.7: n_events_min = 3 (usable events with local depth); see revision_log.

null_calibration: The identical screen is applied to the inverted light curve (2 - f) of every star. The first-screen pass rate on inverted data is the empirical false-alarm rate; thresholds above are FIXED before the run and will not be changed after inspecting results. Any tighter post-hoc cut must be reported as post-hoc.
positive_controls: kic-005689121 (Kuber's 13.769 d candidate; expect P=13.769, depth ~1.4-2.4 ppt)
kic-007603200 (Kepler-138; expect c at 13.781 d ~ 700 ppm and d at 23.09 d)
after_first_screen: Survivors go to: catalogue/ephemeris match (KOI, DR25 TCE, Kepler EB, confirmed planets; same period or 1:2, 2:1, 1:3, 3:1 within 0.1% against anything within 3 arcmin AND against the originating TPF star), TLS refinement, per-year depth consistency, pixel-level localisation on the originating TPF, Gaia neighbour/RUWE check, TRICERATOPS. Nothing is called a planet; survivors are 'first-screen signals', then 'candidates' only after pixel-level localisation and ephemeris clearance.

v18_season_stack_rule.scope: signals with < 5 usable v1.6 quarters; method extension, post-hoc
